zones.label: Clear Communication
zones.summary: Consent is a clear, voluntary, informed, and specific agreement.
facts: Agreement to one thing is not agreement to everything.

zones.label: Ambiguity
zones.summary: Silence, freezing, uncertainty, or mixed signals are reasons to pause.
facts: Ask clearly and accept no or uncertainty.

zones.label: Withdrawal
zones.summary: A person can change their mind at any time.
facts: Stopping when consent is withdrawn is required.
Past agreement does not override a current boundary.

zones.label: Power Difference
zones.summary: Authority, age, dependence, status, or fear can limit free choice.
facts: The person with more power has greater responsibility to avoid pressure.
Seek support when a situation feels unsafe or coercive.

zones.label: Digital Context
zones.summary: Sharing messages or images requires permission and respect for privacy.
facts: Consent to create is not consent to forward.
Save evidence and seek help if someone threatens or pressures.

zones.label: Legal Context
zones.summary: Laws vary by age, relationship, activity, and jurisdiction.
facts: A trusted qualified source can explain local law.
Ethical respect and clear communication remain essential.
